question:
Refer to the following number, symbol series and answer the question. Counting to be done from left to right only. All numbers are single-digit numbers.

(Left) 3 & 6 © 3 6 © € % 6 & 4 9 5 4 % € £ $ % 9 1 (Right)

How many such numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 3 & 6 © 3 6 © € % 6 & 4 9 5 4 % € £ $ % 9 1 (Right)

Now,

Numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol.

So, the needed pattern is: Symbol — Number — Symbol

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da9021f16c80d69b45a1eaa2cdf695b1b578d267d13693b23489864013bf613e.png] Thus, there are 2 such numbers, each of which is immediately preceded by a symbol and also immediately followed by a symbol.
